plugins.label: Dither Lab
plugins.description: Ordered, threshold and stochastic dithering with palette depth and color retention.

passes.source: float h(vec2 p){return fract(sin(dot(p,vec2(12.9,78.2)))*43758.5);} vec4 fx(vec2 uv){vec4 b=inp(uv);vec2 p=floor(uv*uResolution/P1);float ordered=fract((p.x*3.0+p.y*5.0)/8.0);float noise=h(p);float stripes=fract((p.x+p.y)*.5);float d=P2<.5?ordered:(P2<1.5?noise:stripes);float l=dot(b.rgb,vec3(.2126,.7152,.0722));vec3 src=mix(vec3(l),b.rgb,P4);vec3 q=floor(src*(P0-1.0)+d)/(P0-1.0);return vec4(mix(b.rgb,clamp(q,0.0,1.0),P3),b.a);}

plugins.label: Spectral Vision
plugins.description: Thermal, infrared, night-vision and X-ray mappings driven by image luminance and local contrast.

presets.name: Infrared
presets.description: High-contrast false-color foliage and skin rendering.

passes.source: float h(vec2 p){return fract(sin(dot(p,vec2(12.9,78.2)))*43758.5);} vec4 fx(vec2 uv){vec4 b=inp(uv);float l=clamp((dot(b.rgb,vec3(.2126,.7152,.0722))-.5)*P2+.5,0.0,1.0);vec3 thermal=clamp(vec3(1.5-abs(l*4.0-3.0),1.5-abs(l*4.0-2.0),1.5-abs(l*4.0-1.0)),0.0,1.0);vec3 night=vec3(.08,1.0,.18)*pow(l,.65);vec3 ir=mix(vec3(l),vec3(l*1.25,.72*l,1.0-l*.45),.78);vec3 xr=vec3(.12,.85,1.0)*(1.0-l);vec3 c=P0<.5?thermal:(P0<1.5?night:(P0<2.5?ir:xr));c+=(h(floor(uv*uResolution)+floor(uTime*24.0))-.5)*P3;c+=c*smoothstep(.62,1.0,l)*P4*.2;return vec4(mix(b.rgb,clamp(c,0.0,1.0),P1),b.a);}

plugins.label: Fractal Field
plugins.description: Animated procedural fractal noise for backgrounds, mattes, displacement and texture design.

passes.source: float h(vec2 p){return fract(sin(dot(p,vec2(127.1,311.7)))*43758.5);} float n(vec2 p){vec2 i=floor(p),f=fract(p);f=f*f*(3.0-2.0*f);return mix(mix(h(i),h(i+vec2(1,0)),f.x),mix(h(i+vec2(0,1)),h(i+1.0),f.x),f.y);} vec4 fx(vec2 uv){vec2 p=uv*P0+uTime*P2;float v=n(p)*.58+n(p*2.03)*.27*P1+n(p*4.07)*.15*P1;v=clamp((v-.5)*P3+.5,0.0,1.0);vec3 c=mix(vec3(v),hsv2rgb(vec3(fract(P4+v*.22),.82,v)),P5);return vec4(c,1.0);}

plugins.label: Starfield
plugins.description: Layered procedural stars with depth motion, twinkle and optional warp-speed trails.

presets.name: Warp Speed
presets.description: Fast radial star trails for transitions and travel.

passes.source: float h(vec2 p){return fract(sin(dot(p,vec2(127.1,311.7)))*43758.5);} vec4 fx(vec2 uv){vec2 p=uv-.5;float outv=0.0;vec3 col=vec3(0);for(int k=0;k<3;k++){float z=fract(float(k)/3.0+uTime*P2*.04);float sc=mix(18.0,90.0,z);vec2 q=p*sc;vec2 id=floor(q);vec2 f=fract(q)-.5;float rnd=h(id+float(k)*31.0);float star=step(1.0-P0*.12,rnd)*pow(max(0.0,1.0-length(f)/(P1*.12+.02)),8.0);star*=.4+.6*sin(uTime*P3*3.0+rnd*20.0)*.5+.3;float trail=max(0.0,1.0-abs(f.y)*18.0)*max(0.0,1.0-abs(f.x)*2.0)*P4;vec3 tint=mix(vec3(1),hsv2rgb(vec3(rnd,.48,1)),P5);col+=tint*(star+trail*star);outv+=star;}return vec4(col,clamp(outv,0.0,1.0));}

plugins.label: Atmosphere Generator
plugins.description: Procedural clouds, aurora and fog with animated layered depth.

passes.source: float h(vec2 p){return fract(sin(dot(p,vec2(127.1,311.7)))*43758.5);} float n(vec2 p){vec2 i=floor(p),f=fract(p);f=f*f*(3.0-2.0*f);return mix(mix(h(i),h(i+vec2(1,0)),f.x),mix(h(i+vec2(0,1)),h(i+1.0),f.x),f.y);} vec4 fx(vec2 uv){vec2 p=uv*P1+vec2(uTime*P3*.2,0);float v=n(p)+n(p*2.1)*.5+n(p*4.2)*.25;v=v/1.75;float cloud=smoothstep(1.0-P2,1.0,v);float aur=pow(max(0.0,sin((uv.x+n(p*.7)*.4)*14.0+uTime*P3)),3.0)*smoothstep(.15,.8,uv.y);float fog=smoothstep(.72,.05,uv.y)*smoothstep(1.0-P2,1.0,v);float a=P0<.5?cloud:(P0<1.5?aur:fog);vec3 c=hsv2rgb(vec3(fract(P4+a*.18),.62,min(1.0,a*(1.0+P5))));return vec4(c,a);}

plugins.label: Texture Lab
plugins.description: Procedural grunge, paper, concrete and scratched-surface overlays with blend-safe alpha.

passes.source: float h(vec2 p){return fract(sin(dot(p,vec2(127.1,311.7)))*43758.5);} vec4 fx(vec2 uv){vec2 p=uv*P0;float v=h(floor(p*30.0))*.45+h(floor(p*90.0))*.35+h(floor(p*240.0))*.2;v=mix(v,pow(v,2.2),P2);float scratch=step(1.0-P3*.03,h(vec2(floor(uv.x*uResolution.x),7.0)));v=clamp((v-.5)*P1+.5-scratch*.55,0.0,1.0);v=mix(v,1.0-v,step(.5,P4));return vec4(vec3(v),v*P5);}

plugins.label: Turbulent Displace
plugins.description: Layered procedural displacement with independent scale, evolution, complexity and directional bias.

passes.source: float h(vec2 p){return fract(sin(dot(p,vec2(127.1,311.7)))*43758.5);} float n(vec2 p){vec2 i=floor(p),f=fract(p);f=f*f*(3.0-2.0*f);return mix(mix(h(i),h(i+vec2(1,0)),f.x),mix(h(i+vec2(0,1)),h(i+1.0),f.x),f.y);} vec4 fx(vec2 uv){vec2 p=uv*P1+uTime*P3;float a=n(p)*6.283+n(p*2.03)*P2*3.14;vec2 organic=vec2(cos(a),sin(a));float da=radians(P4);vec2 dir=vec2(cos(da),sin(da));vec2 d=mix(organic,dir,P5)*P0/uResolution;return inp(uv+d);}

plugins.label: Ripple & Wave
plugins.description: Radial ripples, directional waves and expanding shockwaves with damping.

passes.source: vec4 fx(vec2 uv){vec2 c=vec2(P3,P4),v=uv-c;float r=length(v);float coord=mix(uv.y,r,step(.5,P5));float wave=sin(coord*P1*6.283+P2+uTime*2.0);float damp=mix(1.0,exp(-r*5.0),P6);vec2 dir=mix(vec2(1,0),normalize(v+1e-5),step(.5,P5));return inp(uv+dir*wave*damp*P0/uResolution);}

plugins.label: Corner Pin
plugins.description: Four-corner perspective placement for screen inserts, signs and planar composites.

presets.name: Left Wall
presets.description: Perspective placement on a receding left wall.

presets.name: Right Wall
presets.description: Perspective placement on a receding right wall.

passes.source: vec4 fx(vec2 uv){vec2 top=mix(vec2(P0,P1),vec2(P2,P3),uv.x);vec2 bot=mix(vec2(P4,P5),vec2(P6,P7),uv.x);vec2 offset=mix(top,bot,uv.y);return inp(uv-offset);}

plugins.label: Mesh Warp
plugins.description: Smooth localized deformation with center, radius, pull, twist and falloff controls.

passes.source: vec4 fx(vec2 uv){vec2 c=vec2(P0,P1),d=uv-c;float r=length(d);float w=pow(max(0.0,1.0-r/P2),P6);float a=-P5*w,cs=cos(a),sn=sin(a);vec2 q=mat2(cs,-sn,sn,cs)*d-vec2(P3,P4)*w;return inp(c+q);}

plugins.label: Bulge & Pinch
plugins.description: High-quality radial bulge, pinch and fisheye with protected outer geometry.

passes.source: vec4 fx(vec2 uv){vec2 c=vec2(P2,P3),d=uv-c;float r=length(d);float w=pow(max(0.0,1.0-r/P1),P4);float scale=1.0-P0*w*.72;return inp(c+d*scale);}

plugins.label: Polar Warp
plugins.description: Rectangular-to-polar conversion, tunnel wrapping and seamless panorama transformations.

presets.name: Tiny Planet
presets.description: Wraps a panorama into a circular planet.

passes.source: vec4 fx(vec2 uv){vec2 p=uv-vec2(P3,P4);float r=length(p)/P2,a=atan(p.y,p.x)/6.283185+.5+P1/360.0;vec2 polar=vec2(a,mix(r,1.0-r,step(.5,P5)));return inp(mix(uv,polar,P0));}

plugins.label: Rolling Shutter Repair
plugins.description: Corrects skew and wobble caused by rolling-shutter readout.

passes.source: vec4 fx(vec2 uv){float scan=mix(uv.x,uv.y,step(.5,P4));float off=P0*(scan-.5)+sin(scan*P2*6.283+P3+uTime)*P1;vec2 d=mix(vec2(0,off),vec2(off,0),step(.5,P4));return inp(uv+d);}

plugins.label: Perspective Warp
plugins.description: Interactive yaw, pitch, roll and depth perspective for screen and graphic placement.

presets.name: Left Plane
presets.description: Rotates the image onto a left-facing plane.

presets.name: Floor Plane
presets.description: Tilts the image into floor perspective.

passes.source: vec4 fx(vec2 uv){vec2 p=uv-vec2(P4,P5);float r=radians(P2),cs=cos(r),sn=sin(r);p=mat2(cs,-sn,sn,cs)*p;float y=radians(P0),x=radians(P1);float z=P3+p.x*sin(y)+p.y*sin(x);vec2 q=vec2(p.x*cos(y),p.y*cos(x))/max(.15,z)+vec2(P4,P5);return inp(q);}

plugins.label: Atmospheric Glow
plugins.description: Hazy volumetric bloom that preserves a clean photographic core.

presets.name: Stage Atmosphere
presets.description: Dense glow around practical and concert light.

passes.source: vec4 fx(vec2 uv){vec4 b=inp(uv);vec2 p=P1/uResolution;vec3 z=vec3(0);for(int i=0;i<12;i++){float a=float(i)*.523599;z+=inp(uv+vec2(cos(a),sin(a))*p).rgb/12.;}float l=max(max(z.r,z.g),z.b);vec3 tint=mix(vec3(.78,.9,1.15),vec3(1.15,.96,.72),P4*.5+.5);vec3 g=z*smoothstep(P2,P2+.24,l)*P0*tint;vec3 c=1.-(1.-b.rgb)*exp(-g);c=mix(c,c+vec3(dot(z,vec3(.2126,.7152,.0722)))*.1,P3);return vec4(c,b.a);}

plugins.label: Lens Flare Designer
plugins.description: Art-directable anamorphic flare with source position, ghosts, streak and optical color.

presets.name: Cinema Blue
presets.description: Cool anamorphic streak and restrained ghosts.

presets.name: Golden Sun
presets.description: Natural warm flare for exterior imagery.

presets.name: Sci-Fi Array
presets.description: Graphic spectral ghosts with a hard core.

passes.source: vec4 fx(vec2 uv){vec4 b=inp(uv);vec2 s=vec2(P0,1.-P1),q=uv-s;float core=exp(-length(q)/max(.005,P3));float line=exp(-abs(q.y)*uResolution.y/max(1.,P3*40.))*exp(-abs(q.x)*2.)*P5;vec2 axis=.5-s;float gh=0.;for(int i=1;i<6;i++){vec2 g=s+axis*float(i)*.34;gh+=exp(-abs(length(uv-g)-P3*(.08+float(i)*.05))*90.)/float(i);}vec3 col=hsv2rgb(vec3(P6,.72,1.));vec3 flare=col*(core+line+gh*P4)*P2;return vec4(1.-(1.-b.rgb)*exp(-flare),b.a);}

plugins.label: Sparkle Field
plugins.description: Highlight-aware star sparkles with scale, density, rotation and elegant twinkle.

presets.name: Luxury Sparkle
presets.description: Fine glints for jewelry and beauty.

passes.source: float hh(vec2 p){return fract(sin(dot(p,vec2(41.7,289.1)))*43758.5);}vec4 fx(vec2 uv){vec4 b=inp(uv);vec2 cell=floor(uv*uResolution/P3),f=fract(uv*uResolution/P3)-.5;float r=hh(cell);float cross=pow(max(0.,1.-min(abs(f.x),abs(f.y))*10.),mix(10.,3.,P4));float lum=max(max(b.r,b.g),b.b);float tw=.25+.75*pow(.5+.5*sin(uTime*P5*4.+r*20.),6.);float v=cross*step(1.-P2,r)*smoothstep(P1,P1+.15,lum)*tw*P0;return vec4(1.-(1.-b.rgb)*exp(-vec3(v)),b.a);}

plugins.label: Caustic Light
plugins.description: Animated refracted light patterns for water, glass and dreamlike projections.

presets.name: Golden Glass
presets.description: Warm refracted patterns for luxury imagery.

passes.source: vec4 fx(vec2 uv){vec4 b=inp(uv);vec2 p=uv*P1;float t=uTime*P2;float a=sin(p.x*2.1+t)+sin(p.y*1.7-t*.8)+sin((p.x+p.y)*1.3+t*.55);float c=pow(.5+.5*sin(a*2.4),P3);vec3 col=hsv2rgb(vec3(P4,.48,1.));return vec4(1.-(1.-b.rgb)*exp(-col*c*P0),b.a);}

plugins.label: Laser & Zap
plugins.description: Fast art-directable energy beam with hot core, glow and animated electrical breakup.

passes.source: float hz(float x){return fract(sin(x*173.3)*43758.5);}vec4 fx(vec2 uv){vec4 b=inp(uv);float a=radians(P2);vec2 d=vec2(cos(a),sin(a)),n=vec2(-d.y,d.x);float along=dot(uv-.5,d);float wig=(sin(along*90.+uTime*23.)+sin(along*217.-uTime*31.))*.004*P4;float dist=abs(dot(uv-.5,n)-P1+.5+wig);float core=exp(-dist*uResolution.y/max(1.,P3));float glow=exp(-dist*uResolution.y/max(1.,P3*5.));vec3 col=hsv2rgb(vec3(P5,.85,1.));vec3 beam=(vec3(core*1.8)+col*glow)*P0;return vec4(1.-(1.-b.rgb)*exp(-beam),b.a);}

plugins.label: Edge-Aware Blur
plugins.description: Bilateral smoothing that removes texture and noise while retaining meaningful edges.

presets.name: Skin Safe
presets.description: Smooth complexion texture with protected features.

presets.name: Graphic Smooth
presets.description: Strong flat-region smoothing for stylized footage.

passes.source: vec4 fx(vec2 uv){vec4 b=inp(uv);float l=dot(b.rgb,vec3(.2126,.7152,.0722));vec3 sum=b.rgb;float w=1.;for(int i=0;i<12;i++){float a=float(i)*.523599;vec3 s=inp(uv+vec2(cos(a),sin(a))*P0/uResolution).rgb;float sl=dot(s,vec3(.2126,.7152,.0722));float q=exp(-abs(sl-l)/max(.001,P1));sum+=s*q;w+=q;}vec3 soft=sum/w;vec3 detail=b.rgb-soft;return vec4(mix(b.rgb,soft+detail*P3,P2),b.a);}

plugins.label: Rack Defocus
plugins.description: Keyframe-friendly focus pull with shaped bokeh and protected in-focus detail.

presets.name: Portrait Pull
presets.description: Elegant focus pull across a face or product.

passes.source: vec4 fx(vec2 uv){float a=radians(P3);vec2 d=vec2(cos(a),sin(a));float q=abs(dot(uv,d)-P0);float m=smoothstep(P1,P1+.18,q);vec3 z=vec3(0);float w=0.;for(int i=0;i<12;i++){float an=float(i)*.523599;vec2 o=vec2(cos(an),sin(an))*P2/uResolution*m;vec3 s=inp(uv+o).rgb;float hi=1.+smoothstep(.68,1.,max(max(s.r,s.g),s.b))*P4;z+=s*hi;w+=hi;}vec3 c=z/w;return vec4(mix(inp(uv).rgb,c,mix(.65,1.,P5)),inp(uv).a);}

plugins.label: Depth Defocus
plugins.description: Depth-selective lens defocus using a luminance-derived depth field, ready for external depth-map input.

presets.name: Far Landscape
presets.description: Holds distant tonal planes in focus.

passes.source: vec4 fx(vec2 uv){vec4 b=inp(uv);float dep=dot(b.rgb,vec3(.2126,.7152,.0722));dep=mix(dep,1.-dep,step(.5,P3));float m=smoothstep(P1,P1+.3,abs(dep-P0));vec3 z=vec3(0);float w=0.;for(int i=0;i<12;i++){float a=float(i)*.523599;vec3 s=inp(uv+vec2(cos(a),sin(a))*P2/uResolution*m).rgb;float k=1.+smoothstep(.7,1.,max(max(s.r,s.g),s.b))*P4;z+=s*k;w+=k;}return vec4(mix(b.rgb,z/w,m),b.a);}

plugins.label: Compound Blur
plugins.description: Image-driven variable blur for frosted glass, heat, dream and organic depth effects.

presets.name: Frosted Glass
presets.description: Soft variable diffusion driven by image detail.

presets.name: Luma Depth
presets.description: Blur increases through darker image regions.

passes.source: vec4 fx(vec2 uv){vec4 b=inp(uv);float map=smoothstep(P1,P2,dot(b.rgb,vec3(.2126,.7152,.0722)));map=mix(map,1.-map,step(.5,P3));vec2 p=P0/uResolution*map;vec4 z=b*.2+(inp(uv+vec2(p.x,0))+inp(uv-vec2(p.x,0))+inp(uv+vec2(0,p.y))+inp(uv-vec2(0,p.y)))*.2;return mix(b,z,P4);}

plugins.label: Motion Field Blur
plugins.description: Curved per-pixel motion trails with shutter, direction, falloff and center controls.

presets.name: Orbit Trail
presets.description: Curved rotational motion around frame center.

passes.source: vec4 fx(vec2 uv){float a=radians(P1);vec2 base=vec2(cos(a),sin(a));vec2 r=uv-vec2(P4,P5);vec2 tang=normalize(vec2(-r.y,r.x)+1e-5);vec2 v=normalize(base+tang*P3)*P0/uResolution*P2;vec4 z=vec4(0);float w=0.;for(int i=0;i<16;i++){float q=float(i)/15.-.5;float k=1.-abs(q)*.65;z+=inp(uv+v*q)*k;w+=k;}return z/w;}

plugins.label: Looks Designer
plugins.description: A one-effect finishing suite combining exposure, film contrast, palette separation, density, fade and rolloff.

presets.name: Prestige Cinema
presets.description: Dense elegant drama with protected highlights.

presets.name: Sunlit Editorial
presets.description: Open luminous lifestyle color with soft warmth.

presets.name: Night Neon
presets.description: Cool shadows and rich protected practicals.

passes.source: vec3 pal(float h){return .5+.5*cos(6.28318*(vec3(0,.333,.667)+h));}vec4 fx(vec2 uv){vec4 b=inp(uv);vec3 c=b.rgb*exp2(P0);c=(c-.435)*P1+.435;float l=dot(c,vec3(.2126,.7152,.0722));float sh=1.-smoothstep(.12,.62,l),hi=smoothstep(.38,.92,l);c+=(pal(P2*.18+.58)-.5)*sh*.1+(pal(P2*.12+.08)-.5)*hi*.08;c=mix(vec3(l),c,P3);c=vec3(P4)+c*(1.-P4);vec3 rolled=c/(1.+max(c-1.,0.));c=mix(c,rolled,P5*smoothstep(.6,1.5,max(max(c.r,c.g),c.b)));return vec4(mix(b.rgb,clamp(c,0.,1.),P6),b.a);}

plugins.label: Selective Mojo
plugins.description: Skin-protected cinematic color separation with cool ambience, warm subjects and controlled saturation.

presets.name: Cinema Subject
presets.description: Warm natural subject separation against cooler ambience.

presets.name: Urban Steel
presets.description: Cooler dramatic environment with retained complexion.

presets.name: Golden Human
presets.description: Luminous warm skin with restrained background color.

passes.source: vec4 fx(vec2 uv){vec4 b=inp(uv);vec3 h=rgb2hsv(b.rgb);float d=abs(h.x-.075);d=min(d,1.-d);float skin=(1.-smoothstep(.07,.2,d))*smoothstep(.08,.3,h.y)*P1;vec3 cool=b.rgb*vec3(1.-P2*.12,1.,1.+P2*.16);vec3 warm=b.rgb*vec3(1.+P3*.16,1.+P3*.03,1.-P3*.12);vec3 c=mix(cool,warm,skin);float l=dot(c,vec3(.2126,.7152,.0722));c=mix(vec3(l),c,P4);c=(c-.435)*P5+.435;return vec4(mix(b.rgb,c,P0),b.a);}

plugins.label: Parametric Curve
plugins.description: Fast toe, shadow, midtone, highlight and shoulder shaping without leaving the effect stack.

presets.name: Gentle S Curve
presets.description: Clean finishing contrast with soft ends.

presets.name: Open Negative
presets.description: Lifted shadow detail and gentle highlight compression.

presets.name: Rich Print
presets.description: Dense print-like lower mids and luminous highs.

passes.source: float cv(float x){float toe=(1.-smoothstep(0.,.22,x))*P0;float sh=exp(-pow((x-.25)/.2,2.))*P1;float mid=exp(-pow((x-P5)/.25,2.))*P2;float hi=exp(-pow((x-.72)/.2,2.))*P3;float sho=smoothstep(.72,1.,x)*P4;return clamp(x+(toe+sh+mid+hi+sho)*.16,0.,1.);}vec4 fx(vec2 uv){vec4 b=inp(uv);return vec4(cv(b.r),cv(b.g),cv(b.b),b.a);}

plugins.label: Guided Color Match
plugins.description: Shot-matching correction controls for exposure, balance, contrast, saturation and black level; reference sampling is Phase 2 multi-input.

presets.name: Flat to Finished
presets.description: General matching transform for flat footage.

passes.source: vec4 fx(vec2 uv){vec4 b=inp(uv);vec3 c=b.rgb*exp2(P0);c*=vec3(1.+P1*.16,1.+P2*.1,1.-P1*.16);c.g*=1.+P2*.06;c=(c-.435)*P3+.435;float l=dot(c,vec3(.2126,.7152,.0722));c=mix(vec3(l),c,P4)+P5;return vec4(mix(b.rgb,c,P6),b.a);}

plugins.label: Adaptive Key
plugins.description: Primatte-style hue/chroma key with foreground certainty, transparency recovery and integrated spill control.

presets.name: Uneven Green Screen
presets.description: Wider adaptive screen acceptance for imperfect lighting.

passes.source: vec4 fx(vec2 uv){vec4 b=inp(uv);vec3 h=rgb2hsv(b.rgb);float d=abs(h.x-P0);d=min(d,1.-d);float chroma=h.y*h.z;float screen=(1.-smoothstep(P1,P1+P2,d))*smoothstep(.04,.32,chroma);float alpha=1.-screen;alpha=mix(alpha,smoothstep(P3*.25,1.-P3*.2,alpha),P3);alpha=mix(alpha,sqrt(alpha),P5*(1.-alpha));float l=dot(b.rgb,vec3(.2126,.7152,.0722));vec3 neutral=vec3(l);vec3 c=mix(b.rgb,neutral,screen*P4);return vec4(c,alpha*b.a);}

plugins.label: Edge Color
plugins.description: Repairs contaminated key edges with inward color, neutralization and controllable edge width.

passes.source: vec4 fx(vec2 uv){vec4 b=inp(uv);vec2 p=P0/uResolution;vec4 x=(inp(uv+vec2(p.x,0))+inp(uv-vec2(p.x,0))+inp(uv+vec2(0,p.y))+inp(uv-vec2(0,p.y)))/4.;float edge=clamp(abs(b.a-x.a)*5.,0.,1.);float l=dot(x.rgb,vec3(.2126,.7152,.0722));vec3 repl=mix(x.rgb,vec3(l),P2)*vec3(1.+P3*.08,1.,1.-P3*.08);return vec4(mix(b.rgb,repl,edge*P1),b.a);}

plugins.label: Garbage & Core Matte
plugins.description: Builds a firm interior core and suppresses uncertain exterior contamination around an existing alpha.

presets.name: Solid Subject
presets.description: Builds a firmer opaque subject core.

passes.source: vec4 fx(vec2 uv){vec4 b=inp(uv);float lo=P2-P3,hi=P2+P3;float core=smoothstep(lo,hi,b.a-P0*.12);float clean=smoothstep(lo+P1*.12,hi,b.a);float a=max(core,clean);vec3 prem=b.rgb*min(1.,a/max(.001,b.a));return mix(vec4(prem,a),vec4(vec3(a),1.),step(.5,P4));}

plugins.label: Key Cleaner
plugins.description: One-click matte cleanup combining edge-preserving smooth, chatter removal, choke and detail recovery.

presets.name: Fine Hair
presets.description: Preserves translucent strands while calming chatter.

passes.source: vec4 fx(vec2 uv){vec4 b=inp(uv);vec2 p=P4/uResolution;float av=(inp(uv+vec2(p.x,0)).a+inp(uv-vec2(p.x,0)).a+inp(uv+vec2(0,p.y)).a+inp(uv-vec2(0,p.y)).a+b.a*4.)/8.;float stable=mix(b.a,av,P0);stable=smoothstep(.5-P1*.35,.5+P1*.35,stable);float a=mix(stable,b.a,P3);a=clamp(a-P2*.15,0.,1.);return vec4(b.rgb*min(1.,a/max(.001,b.a)),a);}

plugins.label: Paint Studio
plugins.description: Painterly color abstraction with edge structure, brush scale, canvas texture and source-color fidelity.

presets.name: Editorial Gouache
presets.description: Flat graphic color with confident edges.

presets.name: Soft Watercolor
presets.description: Luminous loose color with paper texture.

passes.source: float h(vec2 p){return fract(sin(dot(p,vec2(12.9,78.2)))*43758.5);}vec4 fx(vec2 uv){vec2 p=P0/uResolution;vec4 b=inp(uv);vec3 z=vec3(0);for(int i=0;i<8;i++){float a=float(i)*.785398;z+=inp(uv+vec2(cos(a),sin(a))*p).rgb/8.;}z=floor(z*mix(32.,6.,P1))/mix(32.,6.,P1);float gx=length(inp(uv+vec2(p.x,0)).rgb-inp(uv-vec2(p.x,0)).rgb);float gy=length(inp(uv+vec2(0,p.y)).rgb-inp(uv-vec2(0,p.y)).rgb);z*=1.-clamp((gx+gy)*P2,0.,.65);z+=(h(floor(uv*uResolution*.3))-.5)*P3*.12;return vec4(mix(vec3(dot(z,vec3(.2126,.7152,.0722))),z,P4),b.a);}

plugins.label: VHS & CRT
plugins.description: Authentic tape softness, chroma delay, scanlines, head switching and display bloom without unreadable gimmicks.

presets.name: Clean VHS
presets.description: Believable home-video softness and chroma delay.

presets.name: Worn Tape
presets.description: Damaged archival tape with tracking noise.

passes.source: float h(vec2 p){return fract(sin(dot(p,vec2(12.9,78.2)))*43758.5);}vec4 fx(vec2 uv){vec2 p=uv-.5;p*=1.+dot(p,p)*P5*.28;vec2 q=p+.5;float f=floor(uTime*24.);float tear=(h(vec2(f,floor(q.y*60.)))-.5)*P3*.035;float head=smoothstep(.92,1.,q.y)*sin(q.y*240.+f)*P3*.025;q.x+=tear+head;vec2 d=vec2(P1/uResolution.x,0);vec3 c=vec3(inp(q+d).r,inp(q).g,inp(q-d).b);float scan=1.-P2*(.5+.5*sin(q.y*uResolution.y*3.14159));c*=scan;c=mix(c,(inp(q+vec2(2./uResolution.x,0)).rgb+inp(q-vec2(2./uResolution.x,0)).rgb+c)/3.,P0*.35);c+=max(c-.65,0.)*P4;return vec4(c,inp(q).a);}

plugins.label: Analog TV
plugins.description: Broadcast-era RF noise, ghosting, interlace, vertical hold and color instability.

passes.source: float h(vec2 p){return fract(sin(dot(p,vec2(127.1,311.7)))*43758.5);}vec4 fx(vec2 uv){float f=floor(uTime*30.);vec2 q=uv;q.y=fract(q.y+P3*uTime*.08);float n=h(floor(q*uResolution)+f)-.5;float wob=sin(q.y*70.+uTime*8.)*(1.-P0)*.012;q.x+=wob;vec4 b=inp(q);vec3 ghost=inp(q-vec2(.018,0)).rgb;vec3 c=mix(b.rgb,ghost,P1*.45)+n*P2*.32;float field=step(.5,fract(q.y*uResolution.y*.5+mod(f,2.)));c*=1.-field*P4*.14;return vec4(c,b.a);}

plugins.label: Posterize & Solarize
plugins.description: Graphic tonal reduction and photographic solarization with smooth color retention.

passes.source: vec4 fx(vec2 uv){vec4 b=inp(uv);vec3 q=floor(b.rgb*(P0-1.)+.5)/(P0-1.);q=mix(q,smoothstep(vec3(0),vec3(1),q),P3);vec3 sol=mix(q,1.-q,smoothstep(P2-.08,P2+.08,q));q=mix(q,sol,P1);float l=dot(q,vec3(.2126,.7152,.0722));return vec4(mix(vec3(l),q,P4),b.a);}

plugins.label: Relief Studio
plugins.description: Emboss, bas-relief and engraved surface treatments with controllable light direction and material color.

passes.source: vec4 fx(vec2 uv){vec4 b=inp(uv);float a=radians(P1);vec2 d=vec2(cos(a),sin(a))*P2/uResolution;float l1=dot(inp(uv+d).rgb,vec3(.2126,.7152,.0722)),l2=dot(inp(uv-d).rgb,vec3(.2126,.7152,.0722));float e=clamp(.5+(l1-l2)*P0,0.,1.);vec3 mat=mix(vec3(.92,.9,.86),vec3(.38,.45,.58),P3);vec3 c=mat*e;return vec4(mix(c,b.rgb,P4),b.a);}

plugins.label: Neon Contours
plugins.description: Clean luminous edge extraction with dual-color mapping, controllable thickness and source integration.

presets.name: Subtle Edge Light
presets.description: Refined colored rim detail over the source.

passes.source: vec4 fx(vec2 uv){vec4 b=inp(uv);vec2 p=P1/uResolution;float gx=length(inp(uv+vec2(p.x,0)).rgb-inp(uv-vec2(p.x,0)).rgb),gy=length(inp(uv+vec2(0,p.y)).rgb-inp(uv-vec2(0,p.y)).rgb);float e=smoothstep(P2,P2+.2,length(vec2(gx,gy)));vec3 col=hsv2rgb(vec3(fract(P3+e*P4),.88,1.));vec3 glow=col*e*P0;return vec4(1.-(1.-b.rgb*P5)*exp(-glow),b.a);}

plugins.label: Gradient Studio
plugins.description: Linear, radial and conic procedural gradients for backgrounds, overlays and graphic lighting.

presets.name: Cinema Duotone
presets.description: Deep violet to warm amber gradient.

passes.source: vec4 fx(vec2 uv){vec2 p=uv-.5;float a=radians(P1);float lin=dot(p,vec2(cos(a),sin(a)))+.5;float rad=length(p)*1.414;float con=fract(atan(p.y,p.x)/6.28318+P1/360.);float q=P0<.5?lin:(P0<1.5?rad:con);float t=smoothstep(P2-P3*.5,P2+P3*.5,q);vec3 ca=hsv2rgb(vec3(P4,P6,1.)),cb=hsv2rgb(vec3(P5,P6,1.));return vec4(mix(ca,cb,t),1.);}

plugins.label: Advanced Heat Haze
plugins.description: Layered rising refraction with turbulence, directional flow, edge falloff and shimmer.

passes.source: float h(vec2 p){return fract(sin(dot(p,vec2(127.1,311.7)))*43758.5);}float n(vec2 p){vec2 i=floor(p),f=fract(p);f=f*f*(3.-2.*f);return mix(mix(h(i),h(i+vec2(1,0)),f.x),mix(h(i+vec2(0,1)),h(i+1.),f.x),f.y);}vec4 fx(vec2 uv){float a=radians(P4);vec2 d=vec2(cos(a),sin(a));vec2 p=uv*P1-d*uTime*P2;float v=(n(p)+n(p*2.07)*P3*.55-.75);float fade=mix(1.,smoothstep(1.,0.,uv.y),P5);return inp(uv+d*v*P0/uResolution*fade);}

plugins.label: Twirl Warp
plugins.description: Localized optical twirl with smooth protected falloff and animated rotation.

passes.source: vec4 fx(vec2 uv){vec2 c=vec2(P2,P3),d=uv-c;float r=length(d);float w=pow(max(0.,1.-r/P1),P4);float a=-(P0+uTime*P5)*w,cs=cos(a),sn=sin(a);return inp(c+mat2(cs,-sn,sn,cs)*d);}

plugins.label: Prism Displacement
plugins.description: Spectral glass displacement with independent refraction, dispersion, angle and optical edge control.

passes.source: vec4 fx(vec2 uv){float a=radians(P2);vec2 d=vec2(cos(a),sin(a));float facet=floor((dot(uv-.5,d)+.5)*P3)/P3-.5;vec2 o=d*(facet*P0/uResolution.x);float e=P1*P0/uResolution.x;vec3 c=vec3(inp(uv+o+d*e).r,inp(uv+o).g,inp(uv+o-d*e).b);float edge=abs(fract((dot(uv-.5,d)+.5)*P3)-.5)*2.;c+=smoothstep(.82,1.,edge)*P4*.2;return vec4(c,inp(uv).a);}

plugins.label: RGB Separation Pro
plugins.description: Radial, directional or edge-driven chromatic separation with center and falloff controls.

passes.source: vec4 fx(vec2 uv){float a=radians(P1);vec2 direct=vec2(cos(a),sin(a)),r=uv-vec2(P3,P4);vec2 d=mix(direct,normalize(r+1e-5),step(.5,P2));float f=mix(1.,pow(length(r)*1.414,max(.01,P5)),step(.5,P2));vec2 o=d*P0/uResolution*f;return vec4(inp(uv+o).r,inp(uv).g,inp(uv-o).b,inp(uv).a);}

plugins.label: Lens Calibration
plugins.description: Barrel/pincushion correction, tangential decentering, anamorphic squeeze and vignette compensation.

passes.source: vec4 fx(vec2 uv){vec2 p=(uv-.5)/P4;p.x/=P3;float r2=dot(p,p);vec2 q=p*(1.+P0*r2)+vec2(2.*P1*p.x*p.y+P2*(r2+2.*p.x*p.x),P1*(r2+2.*p.y*p.y)+2.*P2*p.x*p.y);q.x*=P3;q+=.5;vec4 c=inp(q);float vig=1.+P5*smoothstep(.18,.72,r2);return vec4(c.rgb*vig,c.a);}

plugins.label: Difference Key
plugins.description: Extracts changed foreground against a synchronized clean plate with color-distance tolerance and edge cleanup.

presets.name: Clean Static Plate
presets.description: Balanced extraction from a stable clean plate.

presets.name: Noisy Plate
presets.description: Wider soft match for compressed or noisy plates.

presets.name: Fine Motion
presets.description: Sensitive extraction for small moving detail.

passes.source: vec4 fx(vec2 uv){vec4 f=inp(uv),p=aux(uv);float d=length(f.rgb-p.rgb)/1.732;float a=smoothstep(P0,P0+P1,d);a=clamp((a-.5-P2*.12)*1.2+.5,0.,1.);vec3 c=mix(f.rgb,f.rgb+(f.rgb-p.rgb)*.2,P3*(1.-a));return vec4(c,a*f.a);}

plugins.label: Light Wrap
plugins.description: Wraps synchronized background light and color naturally around foreground alpha edges.

passes.source: vec4 fx(vec2 uv){vec4 f=inp(uv);vec2 p=P0/uResolution;vec4 bg=(aux(uv+vec2(p.x,0))+aux(uv-vec2(p.x,0))+aux(uv+vec2(0,p.y))+aux(uv-vec2(0,p.y)))/4.;float edge=pow(1.-f.a,P4)*smoothstep(.02,.98,f.a);float l=dot(bg.rgb,vec3(.2126,.7152,.0722));vec3 wrap=mix(vec3(l),bg.rgb,P3)*mix(.4,1.3,smoothstep(.2,.9,l)*P2);return vec4(mix(f.rgb,1.-(1.-f.rgb)*exp(-wrap*P1),edge),f.a);}

plugins.label: Displacement Map
plugins.description: External luminance/RG map displacement with independent axes, neutral point, edge-safe sampling and blur.

presets.name: Texture Surface
presets.description: Fine surface distortion from a texture map.

passes.source: vec4 fx(vec2 uv){vec2 p=P4/uResolution;vec3 m=(aux(uv).rgb+aux(uv+vec2(p.x,0)).rgb+aux(uv+vec2(0,p.y)).rgb)/3.;float l=dot(m,vec3(.2126,.7152,.0722));vec2 v=mix(vec2(l),m.rg,step(.5,P3))-P2;return inp(uv+vec2(v.x*P0/uResolution.x,v.y*P1/uResolution.y));}

plugins.label: Depth Map Defocus
plugins.description: True external depth-map lens defocus with focus plane, range, bokeh radius and highlight response.

presets.name: Portrait Depth
presets.description: Creamy background separation from a depth pass.

presets.name: Miniature Depth
presets.description: Narrow depth plane with stronger defocus.

passes.source: vec4 fx(vec2 uv){vec4 b=inp(uv);float d=dot(aux(uv).rgb,vec3(.2126,.7152,.0722));d=mix(d,1.-d,step(.5,P3));float m=smoothstep(P1,P1+.25,abs(d-P0));vec3 z=vec3(0);float w=0.;for(int i=0;i<12;i++){float a=float(i)*.523599;vec3 s=inp(uv+vec2(cos(a),sin(a))*P2/uResolution*m).rgb;float k=1.+smoothstep(.65,1.,max(max(s.r,s.g),s.b))*P4;z+=s*k;w+=k;}return vec4(mix(b.rgb,z/w,m),b.a);}

plugins.label: Reference Color Match
plugins.description: Pixel-distribution guided reference matching with luminance, palette, saturation and protected-strength controls.

presets.name: Natural Match
presets.description: Balanced reference transfer with protected identity.

presets.name: Luminance Match
presets.description: Matches tonal feel with minimal color transfer.

passes.source: vec4 fx(vec2 uv){vec4 b=inp(uv);vec3 r=aux(uv).rgb;float bl=dot(b.rgb,vec3(.2126,.7152,.0722)),rl=dot(r,vec3(.2126,.7152,.0722));vec3 c=b.rgb*exp2(P0+(rl-bl)*P2);vec3 bh=rgb2hsv(c),rh=rgb2hsv(r);bh.x=mix(bh.x,rh.x,P1);bh.y=mix(bh.y,rh.y,P3);c=hsv2rgb(bh);return vec4(mix(b.rgb,c,P4),b.a);}

plugins.label: Trails
plugins.description: Light-painting trails: bright motion leaves a decaying luminous wake.

presets.name: Light Paint
presets.description: Long, clean trails from practicals and specular highlights.

presets.name: Comet
presets.description: Trails that drift downward and fade quickly.

presets.name: Rainbow Echo
presets.description: Hue shifts along the trail for a prismatic wake.

passes.source: vec4 fx(vec2 uv){ vec4 c=inp(uv); vec2 d=vec2(P4,P5)/uResolution; vec4 p=prev(uv-d); float dec=uDeltaT>0.0?P0:0.0; vec3 t=p.rgb*dec; if(abs(P6)>1e-4){vec3 h=rgb2hsv(t);h.x=fract(h.x+P6*uDeltaT*24.0);t=hsv2rgb(h);} float l=dot(c.rgb,vec3(.2126,.7152,.0722)); vec3 bright=c.rgb*smoothstep(P1-.1,P1+.1,l); vec3 acc= P3<.5?max(t,bright):(P3<1.5?t+bright:(t+bright-t*bright)); vec3 outc=P3<.5?max(c.rgb,acc*P2):c.rgb+ (acc-bright)*P2; return vec4(clamp(outc,0.0,1.0),c.a); }

plugins.label: Echo
plugins.description: Recursive frame echo with offset, decay and colour shift — the classic video echo / Echospace-style multiples.

presets.name: Video Echo
presets.description: Straight offset echoes that fade behind the subject.

presets.name: Spiral
presets.description: Each echo rotates and shrinks toward the centre.

passes.source: vec4 fx(vec2 uv){ vec4 c=inp(uv); if(uDeltaT<=0.0) return c; vec2 q=uv-.5; float r=radians(P4); float cs=cos(r),sn=sin(r); q=mat2(cs,-sn,sn,cs)*q; q=q/P3+.5-vec2(P1,P2)/uResolution; vec4 p=prev(q); float inb=step(0.0,q.x)*step(q.x,1.0)*step(0.0,q.y)*step(q.y,1.0); vec3 e=p.rgb*P0*inb; if(abs(P5)>1e-4){vec3 h=rgb2hsv(e);h.x=fract(h.x+P5);e=hsv2rgb(h);} float ea=p.a*P0*inb; vec3 o; if(P6<.5){ o=mix(e,c.rgb,c.a); } else if(P6<1.5){ o=c.rgb+e; } else { o=c.rgb+e-c.rgb*e; } return vec4(clamp(o,0.0,1.0),max(c.a,ea)); }

plugins.label: Temporal Blur
plugins.description: Long-exposure smoothing across frames; still areas sharpen, moving areas smear.

presets.name: Long Exposure
presets.description: Heavy accumulation: crowds and traffic dissolve into flow.

presets.name: Video Lag
presets.description: Soft, dreamy lag like an old tube camera.

presets.name: Still Smoother
presets.description: Averages only where nothing moves — temporal noise reduction.

passes.source: vec4 fx(vec2 uv){ vec4 c=inp(uv); if(uDeltaT<=0.0) return c; vec4 p=prev(uv); float m=length(c.rgb-prevSrc(uv).rgb); float w=P0*(P1>0.0?1.0-smoothstep(P1*.15,P1*.6,m):1.0); return vec4(clamp(mix(c.rgb,p.rgb,w)*P2,0.0,1.0),c.a); }

plugins.label: Motion Detect
plugins.description: Frame-difference motion: overlay, matte or heat map of what moved since the last frame.

presets.name: Security Overlay
presets.description: Cyan highlight on moving pixels over the picture.

presets.name: Motion Matte
presets.description: White-on-black motion matte for downstream keys.

presets.name: Heat Map
presets.description: Thermal-style ramp from cold stillness to hot movement.

passes.source: vec3 heat(float t){ return clamp(vec3(t*3.0-1.0, t*3.0-.5, 1.0-abs(t*3.0-1.5)*.7)+vec3(0.0,0.0,.2)*(1.0-t),0.0,1.0); } vec4 fx(vec2 uv){ vec4 c=inp(uv); float d=uDeltaT>0.0?length(c.rgb-prevSrc(uv).rgb):0.0; float m=clamp((d-P1)*P0,0.0,1.0); float held=uDeltaT>0.0?prev(uv).a*P3:0.0; m=max(m,held); if(P2<.5){ vec3 col=hsv2rgb(vec3(P4,1.0,1.0)); return vec4(mix(c.rgb,col,m*.85),m); } if(P2<1.5) return vec4(vec3(m),m); if(P2<2.5) return vec4(heat(m),m); return vec4(c.rgb,m); }

plugins.label: Deflicker
plugins.description: Removes frame-to-frame brightness flicker (timelapse, LED lights, archive film) by tracking a running exposure.

presets.name: Timelapse
presets.description: Strong, slow-tracking correction for exposure hunting.

presets.name: LED Flicker
presets.description: Fast response for rolling LED banding brightness.

presets.name: Archive Film
presets.description: Gentle luminance-only smoothing for scanned film.

passes.source: vec4 fx(vec2 uv){ vec4 c=inp(uv); vec3 lumw=vec3(.2126,.7152,.0722); vec3 sum=vec3(0.0); for(int i=0;i<5;i++)for(int j=0;j<5;j++){ sum+=src(vec2(.1+float(i)*.2,.1+float(j)*.2)).rgb; } vec3 meanNow=sum/25.0; float lNow=dot(meanNow,lumw); vec3 meanPrev=meanNow; float lPrev=lNow; if(uDeltaT>0.0){ vec4 h=prev(vec2(.5)); meanPrev=mix(meanNow,h.rgb,1.0-P1); lPrev=mix(lNow,h.a,1.0-P1);} float g=clamp(lPrev/max(lNow,1e-3),1.0/P3,P3); vec3 gc=clamp(meanPrev/max(meanNow,vec3(1e-3)),vec3(1.0/P3),vec3(P3)); vec3 gain=mix(vec3(g),gc,P2); vec3 o=mix(c.rgb,c.rgb*gain,P0); return vec4(clamp(o,0.0,1.0),c.a*0.0+lPrev)*vec4(1.0,1.0,1.0,1.0) + vec4(0.0); }

plugins.label: Datamosh
plugins.description: Codec-style mosh: still regions hold the previous frame while motion smears blocks across it.

presets.name: Classic Mosh
presets.description: Blocks smear through held frames like a broken I-frame.

presets.name: Fine Melt
presets.description: Small blocks and gentle hold for a melting look.

presets.name: Brutal
presets.description: Large blocks, near-total hold, long smears.

passes.source: vec4 fx(vec2 uv){ vec4 c=inp(uv); if(uDeltaT<=0.0) return c; vec2 b=P1/uResolution; vec2 cell=(floor(uv/b)+.5)*b; vec3 dc=c.rgb-prevSrc(cell).rgb; float m=length(inp(cell).rgb-prevSrc(cell).rgb); float moving=smoothstep(P0,P0*2.0+.02,m); vec2 dir=normalize(vec2(dc.r-dc.g,dc.b-dc.g)+1e-4); vec4 held=prev(uv-dir*P3/uResolution*moving); vec3 o=mix(held.rgb,c.rgb,moving*(1.0-P2)+ (1.0-P2)*.15); o=mix(o,mix(o,c.rgb,.5),P4*moving); return vec4(o,c.a); }

plugins.label: Frame Blend
plugins.description: Two-frame blend / ghosting: mixes the previous source frame into the current one.

presets.name: Pulldown Blend
presets.description: Even 50/50 frame blend like a converted broadcast.

presets.name: Ghost
presets.description: Offset screened ghost of the previous frame.

presets.name: Motion Edges
presets.description: Difference blend reveals only what changed.

passes.source: vec4 fx(vec2 uv){ vec4 c=inp(uv); if(uDeltaT<=0.0) return c; vec4 p=prevSrc(uv-vec2(P1,P2)/uResolution); vec3 o; if(P3<.5) o=mix(c.rgb,p.rgb,P0); else if(P3<1.5) o=mix(c.rgb,c.rgb+p.rgb-c.rgb*p.rgb,P0); else o=mix(c.rgb,abs(c.rgb-p.rgb),P0); return vec4(clamp(o,0.0,1.0),c.a); }

plugins.label: Strobe & Freeze
plugins.description: Holds every Nth frame (posterize time) with an optional strobe flash on updates.

presets.name: Posterize 12fps
presets.description: Holds two frames at 24fps for a stop-motion cadence.

presets.name: Stop Motion
presets.description: Holds four frames — animation on fours.

presets.name: Strobe
presets.description: Long holds with a white flash on every update.

passes.source: vec4 fx(vec2 uv){ vec4 c=inp(uv); float n=max(1.0,floor(P0+.5)); float k=mod(uFrame,n); bool update=uDeltaT<=0.0||k<.5; vec4 h=update?c:prev(uv); vec3 o=mix(h.rgb,c.rgb,P2); if(update&&uDeltaT>0.0) o=mix(o,vec3(1.0),P1); return vec4(clamp(o,0.0,1.0),c.a); }

plugins.label: Time Displace
plugins.description: Regions lag behind by a luma or auxiliary map — the slit-scan / time-ripple look.

presets.name: Slit Scan
presets.description: Bottom of frame lags progressively behind the top.

presets.name: Luma Lag
presets.description: Dark regions lag, highlights stay live.

passes.source: vec4 fx(vec2 uv){ vec4 c=inp(uv); if(uDeltaT<=0.0) return c; float m; if(P1<.5) m=dot(c.rgb,vec3(.2126,.7152,.0722)); else if(P1<1.5) m=uv.y; else if(P1<2.5) m=uv.x; else m=dot(aux(uv).rgb,vec3(.333)); m=pow(clamp(m,0.0,1.0),P2); if(P3>.5) m=1.0-m; return vec4(mix(c.rgb,prev(uv).rgb,m*P0),c.a); }

plugins.label: Dust & Dropout Fix
plugins.description: Repairs single-frame dust, scratches and dropouts by borrowing from the previous frame where a defect is isolated in time.

presets.name: Film Dust
presets.description: Small bright/dark specks on scanned film.

passes.source: vec3 hc(float h,float s,float v){ return hsv2rgb(vec3(h,s,v)); } vec4 fx(vec2 uv){ vec4 b=inp(uv); float l=dot(b.rgb,vec3(.2126,.7152,.0722)); vec3 a=hc(P0,P2,l/P3*.5); vec3 z=hc(P1,P2,.35+(l-P3)/max(1.0-P3,.01)*.65); vec3 duo=mix(a,z,smoothstep(P3-.12,P3+.12,l)); return vec4(mix(duo,b.rgb,P4),b.a); }

plugins.label: Editorial Print

presets.description: Bold graphic dots and strong black line character.

passes.source: float hs(vec2 p){ return fract(sin(dot(p,vec2(91.7,271.9)))*43758.5); } vec4 fx(vec2 uv){ vec4 b=inp(uv); float a=radians(P3),cs=cos(a),sn=sin(a); vec2 p=mat2(cs,-sn,sn,cs)*(uv*uResolution)/P0; vec2 q=fract(p)-.5; float l=dot(b.rgb,vec3(.2126,.7152,.0722)); float dotv=smoothstep(.52,.42,length(q)+(.5-l)*P1); vec3 ink=mix(vec3(l),b.rgb,P2)*dotv; float grain=(hs(floor(uv*uResolution*.5))-.5)*P4*.16; return vec4(clamp(ink+grain,0.0,1.0),b.a); }

plugins.label: Lens Warp
plugins.description: Correct or create barrel/pincushion distortion with chromatic fringe and protected borders.

passes.source: vec2 warp(vec2 uv,float k){ vec2 p=(uv-.5)/P2; float r2=dot(p,p); return .5+p*(1.0+k*r2); } vec4 fx(vec2 uv){ vec2 p=warp(uv,P0); vec2 dir=normalize(p-.5+1e-5)*P1/uResolution; vec4 c=vec4(inp(p+dir).r,inp(p).g,inp(p-dir).b,inp(p).a); float v=smoothstep(.78,.18,length((uv-.5)*vec2(uResolution.x/uResolution.y,1.0))); c.rgb*=mix(1.0,v,P3); return c; }

plugins.label: Fluid Warp
plugins.description: Smooth animated displacement for heat, water, dream states and organic transitions.

presets.name: Heat Haze

presets.name: Underwater
presets.description: Broad slow refraction with layered organic movement.

presets.name: Liquid Dream
presets.description: Strong flowing displacement for surreal transitions.

passes.source: vec4 fx(vec2 uv){ float a=radians(P3); vec2 flow=vec2(cos(a),sin(a))*uTime*P2*.12; vec2 p=uv*P1+flow; float n=sin(p.x*5.1+sin(p.y*3.7))+cos(p.y*4.3+sin(p.x*2.9)); n+=sin((p.x+p.y)*9.0+uTime*P2)*P4*.45; vec2 d=vec2(cos(n*2.1),sin(n*1.7))*P0/uResolution; return inp(uv+d); }

passes.source: vec4 fx(vec2 uv){ vec2 p=1.0/uResolution; vec3 c=inp(uv).rgb; float l=dot(c,vec3(.2126,.7152,.0722)); float gx=dot(inp(uv+vec2(p.x,0)).rgb-inp(uv-vec2(p.x,0)).rgb,vec3(.2126,.7152,.0722)); float gy=dot(inp(uv+vec2(0,p.y)).rgb-inp(uv-vec2(0,p.y)).rgb,vec3(.2126,.7152,.0722)); float e=smoothstep(P2,P2+.18,length(vec2(gx,gy))); return vec4(c*e,e); }
vec4 fx(vec2 uv){ vec2 x=vec2(P1/uResolution.x,0),y=vec2(0,P1/uResolution.y); return inp(uv)*.28+(inp(uv+x)+inp(uv-x)+inp(uv+y)+inp(uv-y))*.13+(inp(uv+x+y)+inp(uv-x+y)+inp(uv+x-y)+inp(uv-x-y))*.05; }
vec4 fx(vec2 uv){ vec4 b=src(uv); vec3 tint=hsv2rgb(vec3(P3,.82,1.0)); vec3 g=mix(inp(uv).rgb,inp(uv).aaa*tint,P4)*P0; vec3 o=1.0-(1.0-b.rgb)*exp(-g); return vec4(clamp(o,0.0,1.0),b.a); }

passes.source: vec4 fx(vec2 uv){ vec2 radial=normalize(uv-.5+1e-5); float a=radians(P2); vec2 linear=vec2(cos(a),sin(a)); vec2 dir=mix(linear,radial,step(.5,P1)); float edge=mix(1.0,smoothstep(P3,1.0,length((uv-.5)*1.414)),step(.5,P1)); vec2 d=dir*P0*edge/uResolution; vec4 b=inp(uv); vec3 c=vec3(inp(uv+d).r,b.g,inp(uv-d).b); return vec4(mix(b.rgb,c,P4),b.a); }

passes.source: vec4 fx(vec2 uv){ vec2 p=1.0/uResolution; vec4 b=inp(uv); vec3 avg=(b.rgb+inp(uv+vec2(p.x,0)).rgb+inp(uv-vec2(p.x,0)).rgb+inp(uv+vec2(0,p.y)).rgb+inp(uv-vec2(0,p.y)).rgb)/5.0; vec3 c=mix(b.rgb,avg,P4); float l=dot(c,vec3(.2126,.7152,.0722)); c=mix(vec3(l),c,P3); c=floor(c*P0+.5)/P0; float gx=length(inp(uv+vec2(p.x,0)).rgb-inp(uv-vec2(p.x,0)).rgb); float gy=length(inp(uv+vec2(0,p.y)).rgb-inp(uv-vec2(0,p.y)).rgb); float line=smoothstep(P2,P2+.12,length(vec2(gx,gy)))*P1; return vec4(mix(c,vec3(0.015),line),b.a); }

plugins.label: Analog Damage

passes.source: float hh(vec2 p){ return fract(sin(dot(p,vec2(12.9898,78.233)))*43758.5453); } vec4 fx(vec2 uv){ float band=floor(uv.y*120.0); float tear=(hh(vec2(band,floor(uTime*8.0)))-.5)*P0*smoothstep(.78,1.0,hh(vec2(band*.3,floor(uTime*3.0)))); vec2 q=vec2(fract(uv.x+tear),fract(uv.y+uTime*P4*.08)); vec2 cd=vec2(P1/uResolution.x,0); vec4 b=inp(q); vec3 c=vec3(inp(q+cd).r,b.g,inp(q-cd).b); float n=(hh(floor(uv*uResolution*.7)+floor(uTime*24.0))-.5)*P2; float scan=1.0-sin(uv.y*uResolution.y*3.14159)*P3*.12; float hi=smoothstep(.65,1.0,max(max(c.r,c.g),c.b)); c+=inp(q-vec2(P5*10.0/uResolution.x,0)).rgb*hi*P5*.18; return vec4(clamp(c*scan+n,0.0,1.0),b.a); }

plugins.label: Invert
plugins.description: Invert

passes.source: vec4 fx(vec2 uv){ vec4 c=inp(uv); return vec4(mix(c.rgb, 1.0-c.rgb, P0), c.a); }

plugins.label: Color
plugins.description: Color

passes.source: vec4 fx(vec2 uv){ vec4 c=inp(uv); vec3 h=rgb2hsv(c.rgb); h.x=fract(h.x+P3/360.0); h.y*=P2; vec3 r=hsv2rgb(h); r=(r-0.5)*P1+0.5; r*=P0; return vec4(clamp(r,0.0,1.0), c.a); }

plugins.label: Blur
plugins.description: Blur

passes.source: vec4 fx(vec2 uv){ vec2 px=P0/uResolution; vec4 s=vec4(0.0); float w=0.0; for(int i=-4;i<=4;i++){ for(int j=-4;j<=4;j++){ float g=exp(-float(i*i+j*j)/8.0); s+=inp(uv+vec2(float(i),float(j))*px*0.6)*g; w+=g; } } return s/max(w,1e-3); }

plugins.label: Glow
plugins.description: Glow

passes.source: vec4 fx(vec2 uv){ vec4 base=inp(uv); vec2 px=P1/uResolution; vec3 b=vec3(0.0); float w=0.0; for(int i=-4;i<=4;i++){ for(int j=-4;j<=4;j++){ float g=exp(-float(i*i+j*j)/8.0); vec3 s=inp(uv+vec2(float(i),float(j))*px*0.7).rgb; b+=max(s-0.6,0.0)*g; w+=g; } } return vec4(base.rgb + (b/max(w,1e-3))*P0*3.0, base.a); }

plugins.label: Pixelate
plugins.description: Pixelate

passes.source: vec4 fx(vec2 uv){ vec2 d=P0/uResolution; vec2 q=(floor(uv/d)+0.5)*d; return inp(q); }

plugins.label: RGB Shift
plugins.description: RGB Shift

passes.source: vec4 fx(vec2 uv){ vec2 o=vec2(P0/uResolution.x,0.0); float r=inp(uv+o).r; float g=inp(uv).g; float b=inp(uv-o).b; return vec4(r,g,b, inp(uv).a); }

plugins.label: Vignette
plugins.description: Vignette

passes.source: vec4 fx(vec2 uv){ vec4 c=inp(uv); float d=distance(uv, vec2(0.5)); float v=smoothstep(0.8, 0.2, d*1.3); return vec4(c.rgb*mix(1.0, v, P0), c.a); }

plugins.label: Sharpen
plugins.description: Sharpen

passes.source: vec4 fx(vec2 uv){ vec2 px=1.0/uResolution; vec4 c=inp(uv); vec4 s=inp(uv+vec2(px.x,0.))+inp(uv-vec2(px.x,0.))+inp(uv+vec2(0.,px.y))+inp(uv-vec2(0.,px.y)); return vec4(clamp(c.rgb + (c.rgb*4.0 - s.rgb)*P0, 0.0, 1.0), c.a); }

plugins.label: Mirror
plugins.description: Mirror

passes.source: vec4 fx(vec2 uv){ if(P0<0.5) uv.x=uv.x<0.5?uv.x:1.0-uv.x; else if(P0<1.5) uv.y=uv.y<0.5?uv.y:1.0-uv.y; else { uv.x=uv.x<0.5?uv.x:1.0-uv.x; uv.y=uv.y<0.5?uv.y:1.0-uv.y; } return inp(uv); }

plugins.label: Shake

passes.source: vec4 fx(vec2 uv){ float t=uTime*30.0; vec2 o=vec2(sin(t*1.7),cos(t*2.3))*(P0*(0.3+iBass))/uResolution; return inp(uv+o); }
